data.title: 久岛鸥 · 阁楼木地板上的终极宝藏
data.description: 阳光从阁楼天窗倾泻而下，照亮空气中漂浮的微尘。背心裙的排扣被悉数解开，鸥双膝微分跪坐在木地板上，眼角带着喜悦的泪花，把最珍贵的自己作为唯一的宝藏献出。
data.location: high attic loft with circular stained glass window and warm cedar floorboards
data.action: kneeling on cedar planks in unbuttoned parted pinafore dress, arms open wide with tears of profound joyful love, offering herself completely
data.lighting: dazzling golden god-rays cutting through dust motes enveloping both in celestial warmth
data.mood: transcendent emotional catharsis, sacred lovers culmination, purest promise fulfilled
data.promptProse: Bathed in celestial attic skylight, Kamome kneels with unbuttoned dress, weeping sweet tears of complete, ecstatic romantic union.
data.animaCaption: Kamome kneeling in golden attic light with parted dress, weeping joyful tears of love.
